enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +4: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +4 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Conjuration Focus +1: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Conjuration spells.
Wizardry III: This item grants the wearer +75 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
